results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if object API name unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate candidate non-standard objects using SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_CUSTOM_OBJECTS (paginate while pagination.has_next_page=true).

[Required] [Step]: Retrieve authoritative field + relationship metadata using SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT (use fields[].name/label/type/custom/relationshipName/referenceTo plus queryable/filterable/groupable as available).

[Optional (if describe/query payload is truncated or offloaded)] [Prerequisite]: Parse/filter large responses using COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH (extract needed fields[] or data.records before building queries).
[Optional (if starting from ambiguous text identifiers)] [Prerequisite]: Find likely objects/records using SALESFORCE_EXECUTE_SOSL_SEARCH, then map hits to the correct sObject + Id before querying.
[Optional (if schema probing via SOQL is brittle)] [Prerequisite]: Inspect metadata via SALESFORCE_TOOLING_QUERY (iterate in small queries to avoid MALFORMED_QUERY while exploring field definitions).
[Required] [Step]: Validate schema + filters using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (COUNT() or small LIMIT) and fix INVALID_FIELD/INVALID_TYPE/MALFORMED_QUERY and relationship-path issues before scaling.
[Required] [Step]: Pull target records/aggregates using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (select only needed fields; paginate via data.done/data.nextRecordsUrl until done=true).
[Optional (for spot-checking runtime shapes)] [Next Step]: Fetch a single record using SALESFORCE_GET_S_OBJECT_RECORD (confirm nullability, picklist storage, and relationship fields).
[Optional (if picklist values vary by record type)] [Next Step]: Fetch allowed values using SALESFORCE_GET_PICKLIST_VALUES_BY_RECORD_TYPE (validate downstream logic inputs).
[Fallback (if standard query misses expected rows)] [Fallback]: Re-run the equivalent query using SALESFORCE_QUERY_ALL (include soft-deleted/archived where supported).
known_pitfalls: [SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT] Describe payloads can be very large and previews may truncate/offload; treat the returned fields[] as the source of truth.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] HTTP 400s often include INVALID_FIELD, INVALID_TYPE, INVALID_QUERY_FILTER_OPERATOR, and MALFORMED_QUERY from wrong API names or relationship paths.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Pagination uses data.done plus data.nextRecordsUrl; misreading these can look like missing/empty results.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Aggregate queries return AggregateResult rows; read the selected alias key in data.records[] rather than expecting normal row fields.
[SALESFORCE_TOOLING_QUERY] Tooling metadata queries may fail with MALFORMED_QUERY when using large OR/disjunction clauses; split into multiple queries and merge results.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Keyset pagination pattern to pull large result sets via repeated SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY calls
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
def fetch_all(base_query):
    out=[]
    last_id='000000000000000'
    while True:
        q=base_query.replace(':lastId', f"'{last_id}'")
        r,e=run_composio_tool('SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY',{'query':q})
        if e: break
        rows=(r.get('data',{}) or {}).get('records',[])
        if not rows: break
        out.extend(rows)
        last_id=rows[-1].get('Id')
        if len(rows)<2000: break
    return out
```

SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT.description: Retrieves all fields (standard and custom) for a Salesforce object with complete metadata including field types, constraints, picklist values, and relationships.

object_name.description: API name of the Salesforce object to describe. Use standard object names (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity) or custom object API names ending in __c.

SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

examples: SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate > 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts) FROM Account
SELECT COUNT() FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT COUNT(Id), StageName FROM Opportunity GROUP BY StageName
SELECT Id, Name FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'O\'Brien'
SELECT Id, Name, Description FROM Account LIMIT 10
query.description: SOQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT. Field names must match object schema exactly — use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT for unfamiliar objects. ALIASES: No 'AS' keyword (use 'SUM(Amount) TotalSales' NOT 'SUM(Amount) AS TotalSales'). AGGREGATES: Without GROUP BY, ORDER BY/LIMIT not allowed (single-row result). COUNT() SYNTAX: Bare COUNT() only valid alone. With GROUP BY or other fields, must specify field: COUNT(Id) or COUNT(fieldName). Example: 'SELECT COUNT(Id), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status' NOT 'SELECT COUNT(), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status'. NON-GROUPABLE: Long text, rich text, encrypted text, compound address/location fields. NON-FILTERABLE: Long text area, rich text, encrypted text, multi-select picklists, blob fields CANNOT be in WHERE. FIELDS(ALL)/FIELDS(CUSTOM) require LIMIT ≤200. ID values need single quotes. Apostrophes use backslash: 'O\'Brien'.

SALESFORCE_QUERY_ALL.description: Tool to execute SOQL queries including soft-deleted and archived records. Use when you need to query records that have been deleted via merge or delete operations, or when accessing archived Task and Event records.

examples: SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE IsDeleted = true
SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact
SELECT Id, Subject, Status FROM Task WHERE IsArchived = true
SELECT Id, Name, Amount FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
query.description: The SOQL query to execute. Unlike standard queries, QueryAll includes soft-deleted records (from merge or delete operations) and archived Task/Event records. Example: 'SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE IsDeleted = true'. Use standard SOQL syntax.
